title: ONE BLADE, THREE MEN — a 10-minute cut
notes: Eighteen scenes of ~32 s = 9 min 36 s. Each scene is built by the same engine
as the 30-second test, so nothing here is a placeholder: swap a 'set' or a
'title' and you get a different film with the same rhythm.
Acts follow the classic five: world, escalation, fall, awakening, resolution.
No narration, no dialogue: every act has to be legible from action alone.

acts.title: The world and the first meeting
acts.beat: Two men, one arena, no words. Establish the ground that will later be broken.

acts.title: Escalation: the weapon is not reliable
acts.beat: Weapons are lost, broken and replaced. First unarmed exchange. The crowd grows.

acts.title: The fall and the awakening
acts.beat: He is beaten down. A Ma hold. Silence. The ground lifts and the power wakes.

acts.title: Superpowers at scale
acts.beat: Flash-steps, lightning, beams, a battlefield that stops being a battlefield.

acts.title: Resolution
acts.beat: Dust settling over the field. The winner, and the cost.

scenes.title: A: the crowd steps out of the trees
D: the sky fills with stones
